predict.title: Predict Onion Yield
predict.subtitle: Choose your district and season. We fill in the weather, satellite and soil data for you.
predict.waitingDescription: Choose your field details and tap Predict Yield to get the AI analysis
predict.intervalConformal: {pct}% conformal prediction interval, calibrated on leave-one-year-out residuals. The true yield falls in this range {pct} times out of 100.
predict.intervalGaussian: Range estimated as ±1.96 × the model's error (RMSE). Approximate, not calibrated.
predict.intervalHeuristic: Rough ±15% estimate only — this model has no calibrated interval yet.

reliabilityNote.high: This model explains most of the variation in past harvests. Treat the range as a solid guide.
reliabilityNote.medium: This model explains some of the variation in past harvests. Use the range alongside your own judgement.
reliabilityNote.low: This model explains very little of the variation in past harvests — it is close to predicting the district average. Treat the range as a rough guide only, not a forecast.
reliabilityNote.unknown: Model accuracy has not been recorded. Treat this as an indication only.

predict.dataSourcesBody: Built from {user} of {total} values you supplied and {records} filled in from records for your area.
predict.zeroFillWarning: {n} values had no record at all and were left empty — treat this prediction with extra caution.

predict.error: Prediction failed — backend unavailable. Please try again later.
predict.districtsError: Could not load districts — backend unavailable.

recommend.expertDesc: Need more specific advice? Connect with a local agriculture officer.
recommend.irrigationDesc: Increase water supply during dry periods to stabilize yield.
recommend.heatDesc: Use mulching or shade techniques to reduce heat stress.
recommend.phDesc: Balance soil pH using lime or sulfur for optimal growth.
recommend.nutrientDesc: Apply balanced NPK fertilizer for better bulb development.
recommend.pestDesc: Monitor and control pests during critical growth stages.
